name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, offline tool that clones voices, dubs videos, and turns text into natural-sounding speech in hundreds of languages, without paying a per-minute cloud service.
buyer: A podcast or e-learning studio that currently pays a monthly cloud voice-AI bill to dub and narrate content and wants that cost gone for good.
business_use_cases: A course creator uses it to dub their English video course into a dozen languages overnight, selling the same course in new markets without hiring voice actors.
A podcast network uses the local voice cloning to generate consistent host-voice ad reads and intros without booking studio time for every episode.
An audiobook publisher uses it to produce narrated audiobooks for backlist titles that never sold enough to justify a human narrator.

money_ideas.idea: Run it as a hosted dubbing/narration service for creators who don't want to self-host, charging per minute of audio produced.
Sell a managed version with a simple upload-and-download web UI to small studios and course platforms.

steal_this: Set up a one-weekend 'dub your YouTube channel into 5 languages' service for small creators, using this tool on the backend and charging a flat fee per video.
